thingsToDo.title: Explore Mission San Carlos Borromeo de Carmelo
thingsToDo.description: Mission San Carlos Borromeo de Carmelo, commonly called Carmel Mission, was founded in 1771 and relocated to its current Carmel Valley site in 1771–1772 under Junípero Serra during Spanish Alta California mission expansion. The complex became headquarters for the California mission system and preserves a historic basilica, courtyards, and cemetery associated with the colonial period. It was designated a National Historic Landmark in 1960 and remains an active parish as well as a museum property. Its founding date, religious administrative role, and landmark status provide documented evidence of how settlement patterns and mission-era architecture shaped the Monterey Peninsula long before Carmel-by-the-Sea developed as a twentieth-century arts and tourism town.
